items.title: Supreme Court Upholds Validity Of Section 45 PMLA, Says Twin Conditions For Bail Do Not Violate Article 21
items.summary: A three-judge bench held that the twin conditions for bail under Section 45 of the Prevention of Money Laundering Act do not violate Article 21, but directed that the accused must be heard before remand.
bullets: Bench: CJI Surya Kant, Justice Pankaj Mithal, Justice V. Mohana
Twin conditions read down to include right of hearing before remand
Court clarifies 'reasonable grounds to believe guilty' test
items.case_name: K. Vijay Kumar v. Union of India
items.ratio: Section 45 PMLA twin conditions survive Article 21 scrutiny, but an accused must be heard before remand is extended.

items.title: Allahabad High Court: Registration Of FIR Cannot Be Refused Merely Because Dispute Is Civil In Nature
items.summary: The court observed that a criminal case cannot be quashed at the FIR stage merely because the underlying transaction is contractual, and asked police to complete the investigation within three months.
bullets: Single judge bench of Justice Manish Kumar Nigam
Directions issued for time-bound investigation
Reliance placed on Lalita Kumari v. State of UP
items.case_name: Rakesh Gupta v. State of UP
items.ratio: A civil colour to the dispute is not by itself a ground to refuse registration of an FIR.

items.title: Lok Sabha Passes Bharatiya Sakshya (Second Amendment) Bill, Electronic Records Get Wider Admissibility
items.summary: The bill expands the definition of electronic records to include cloud-stored data and digital signatures while adding a certificate requirement for admissibility under the new evidence law.
bullets: Certificate requirement retained for electronic evidence
Rajya Sabha to take up the bill on Tuesday

items.title: Judicial Appointment: Supreme Court Collegium Recommends Two Chief Justices For Elevation To Top Court
items.summary: The collegium recommended the Chief Justices of the Rajasthan and Kerala High Courts for appointment as judges of the Supreme Court, ending a two-month vacancy.
bullets: Recommendation marks third set of SC appointments in 2026
Pending strength of the court drops from 34 to 32

items.title: Cabinet Clears Data Protection Rules, Sets 18-Month Compliance Window For Platforms
items.summary: The Union Cabinet approved the rules under the DPDP Act, including a phased compliance timeline and a penalty framework that can reach Rs 250 crore for major breaches.
bullets: Rules to be notified within a week
Consent managers get separate registration regime
Penalties up to Rs 250 crore for data breaches

items.title: Centre Notifies Constitution Bench To Hear Pleas Seeking Review Of 'Basic Structure' Reference
items.summary: The Union government notified a nine-judge bench to hear petitions arising from the reference on judicial primacy, with hearings expected to begin in the first week of December.
bullets: Nine-judge bench, led by the CJI
Hearings expected from December 2
Reference arises from NJAC judgment of 2015

items.title: Retail Inflation Eases To 4.1% In October, Lowest In Four Years
items.summary: Consumer price inflation eased to 4.1 per cent in October helped by falling food prices, staying below the RBI's 4 per cent tolerance midpoint and strengthening the case for a rate cut.
bullets: Food inflation at 3.6 per cent, down from 5.2 per cent
RBI's next policy review on December 5

items.title: The Long Road To Judicial Vacancies: Collegium Reform Needs Transparency, Not Speed
items.summary: With 32 vacancies in the higher judiciary, the editorial argues that faster appointments alone will not fix the system unless the collegium publishes reasons for its choices.
bullets: Vacancies have hovered above 30 for two years
Editorial calls for published collegium resolutions

items.title: Why The New Evidence Law Needs A Digital Forensics Bench, Not Just Certificates
items.summary: The column argues that admissibility reforms mean little without trained forensic examiners and a certification authority, and suggests a standing digital forensics cadre.
bullets: Points to backlog of electronic evidence certificates
Proposes a standing digital forensics cadre
